en: You found your way through the hedges in the dark! My gardener swears even he gets lost in here.
Every evening I have a few fireworks set off over the fountain. Would you care to watch them with me?
Back for the fireworks again? There are always a few left. Shall I give the signal?
Magnificent! My Furfrou hides under the bench for them, mind you. Come back any evening you like.
As you wish. They will light up the sky every evening, whenever you are ready.
